baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object chain after اغفر expands from the speaker to parents, a believing entrant, and all believing men and women.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forgiveness moves through concentric relations: self, inherited kin, a person crossing into the household, then an unrestricted faith collective. The sequence turns a private plea into widening intercession without erasing the distinct routes of birth, entry, and trusting assent.

activation_trace.role: Forgiving while shielding from consequence supplies the single protection extended across every named ring.
Parents by birth relation supply the inherited inner ring of beneficiaries.
Going in supplies a second, enacted route into the protected circle.
Household and family make the house a social unit that can receive someone beyond birth kin.
Trusting assent unifies the singular entrant with the final male and female collectives.

changed_reading.before: A list of separate people for whom pardon is requested.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately widening intercession in which birth, admission, and faith are distinct but nested bonds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ولمن دخل بيتي مؤمنا makes belief the state in which entry occurs, not a detached label elsewhere in the list.
baseline_models.mechanism: The house is a sheltered household with a permeable threshold. Entry can mix an outsider into its interior, but secure, confirming faith qualifies that crossing; mere physical presence does not define membership.

activation_trace.role: An entrant mixed into a group supplies the social boundary-crossing latent in دخل.
The hidden interior makes entry a movement into an inward domain, not only across a doorway.
Shelter and dwelling give the threshold a concrete protective side.
Settled security and trust provide the condition that stabilizes admission.

changed_reading.before: A believing visitor happens to enter a literal house.
changed_reading.after: A trust-qualified entrant crosses into a protected interior and becomes socially affiliated with its household.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address رب stands over the paired requests اغفر and لا تزد ... إلا تبارا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship, nurture, and even the split root's rising image place increase under governance. The prayer asks for protective completion on one side while restricting the wrongfully placed or withholding side to an increase whose only product is its own nullification.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the power that governs both protection and increase.
Repair, nurture, and completion define constructive growth as measured care.
The non-dominant split target's increase and rising image creates a cautious internal echo of تزد.
Protective covering supplies the preserving operation assigned to the admitted community.
Increase and growth supply the operator whose allowable output the final clause constrains.
Concrete misplacement or mistiming casts wrongdoing as a process out of proper measure.
Destruction, nullification, and breaking make dismantling the sole permitted increase for that process.

changed_reading.before: A prayer for mercy followed by an unrelated request for harsher punishment.
changed_reading.after: One act of governed growth: preserve and complete the trusted circle, but let disordered power generate only its own dismantling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier address repeatedly works inside the bounded category of one people. The focus moves through one faith-qualified entrant to explicitly believing men and women, so the household becomes a gateway from a local people to a wider trust-defined community.

activation_trace.role: The people or men's collective supplies the bounded social group that the focus later widens.
An entrant joining a group provides the individual bridge out of inherited collective boundaries.
Household affiliation supplies the local social unit that can be expanded.
Trusting assent replaces one people's boundary with the repeated criterion shared by entrant, men, and women.

structural_cues: 71:1-5 repeatedly addresses قوم, while 71:28 progresses from one entrant to explicit believing men and believing women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded قوم and the focus's singular-to-gendered-plural expansion; I infer that the list deliberately rescales affiliation from one people to a faith community. A live alternative is ordinary beneficiary enumeration without a social-boundary claim.

changed_reading.before: The final plurals merely add more recipients to a household prayer.
changed_reading.after: The singular doorway mediates a shift from one people and one household to a gender-inclusive community organized by faith.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah stages incompatible coverings. Forgiveness offers a consequence-shield; rejecters disable receptive hearing and wrap themselves; later disbelief conceals truth while profligacy tears a protective limit. The focus's اغفر therefore asks for the restorative covering that self-enclosure and truth-concealment refused, with faith as secure trust rather than concealment.

activation_trace.role: Forgiving and shielding from consequence supplies the offered protective cover that the following actions resist.
Listening and accepting what is heard make blocked ears a refusal of receptive admission.
A cover laid over something supplies the rejecters' self-enclosing counter-cover.
Garment and covering materialize the self-enclosure immediately after forgiveness is offered.
Concealing truth supplies the later ethical form of the false cover.
Deviation and tearing through a cover supply the complementary breach of a rightful limit.
Protective covering turns the final imperative into the requested true cover.
Settled security and trust define the people able to inhabit that cover without hiding truth.

structural_cues: 71:7 places the forgiveness-purpose clause immediately before fingers in ears and self-envelopment in garments.
71:27 places فاجرا beside كفارا immediately before the focus returns to اغفر and المؤمنين والمؤمنات.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated covering branches, blocked hearing, and the final faith terms; I infer that these covers function as rivals, with divine shielding answering self-protective refusal and truth-concealment. A live alternative is that the garment action and the lexical cover images remain independent motifs.

changed_reading.before: اغفر repeats a general request for pardon after the mission has failed.
changed_reading.after: اغفر requests the one protective cover that reverses the surah's sequence of blocked hearing, self-envelopment, breached limits, and concealed truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A repeated clause engine makes normally beneficial inputs yield a sole negative output: the call increases flight, wealth and offspring increase loss, and the near-identical 71:24 clause increases wrongdoers only in deviation. Against constructive connected extension, the focus changes the terminal object from deviation to breaking, making تبار the last stage of a self-amplifying trajectory rather than an isolated penalty.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the recurring operator first attached to the call's failed effect.
The repeated increase operator supplies the exact syntactic scaffold reused in the focus.
Flight and escape supply the first sole negative yield of an attempted benefit.
Connected increase that supports another thing supplies the constructive extension against which the failed increases stand.
General diminishment supplies the second sole yield, where apparent accumulation produces subtraction.
Deviation from guidance supplies both the propagated harm and the focus clause's immediately prior terminal object.
Increase and growth carry the established operator into the closing request.
Nullification and breaking replace deviation as the chain's terminal, non-reproductive output.

structural_cues: 71:6, 71:21, 71:24, and 71:28 repeatedly use an increase-plus-restrictive-exception pattern whose negative complement intensifies from flight or loss to deviation and breaking.
71:24 and 71:28 share ولا تزد الظالمين إلا with only the final noun changed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated operator, sole-output syntax, and a contrasting connected extension; I infer a directional chain in which rejected goods recursively expose and intensify an orientation until it collapses. A live alternative is that each construction is a separate rhetorical parallel with no staged progression.

changed_reading.before: The final line independently asks for ever greater destruction of wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The final line closes an anti-increment series: misdirected accumulation ceases to reproduce flight, loss, or deviation and reaches nullification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first offers sons as extension, then shows wealth and offspring increasing loss, and finally predicts births marked by breach and concealment. The focus answers with a different continuity: parents are honored as inherited relation, but a believer can enter the household and the prayer then embraces all believing men and women. Faith-qualified affiliation interrupts the claim that biological reproduction controls the future.

activation_trace.role: Sonship, lineage, and derivation supply offspring as an apparent vehicle of continuity.
Birth and delivery supply the projected mechanism by which the rejected order would reproduce itself.
Deviation and rupture of a cover characterize one predicted product of that birth line.
Concealment of truth characterizes the paired predicted product of that birth line.
Parents by birth relation preserve genealogy as one honored bond without making it the only bond.
An entrant joining a group supplies affiliation not produced by descent.
Household and family provide the social body in which inherited and admitted relations can coexist.
Trusting assent supplies the transmissible criterion that reaches beyond a single birth line.

structural_cues: 71:12 presents sons as an extension, 71:21 couples wealth and offspring with increased loss, and 71:27 predicts what continued birth will produce.
71:28 moves from parents to an entrant and then to all believing men and women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing birth outcomes and the focus's mixed kin-entry-faith list; I infer that admitted faith-community is offered as an alternative carrier of continuity. A live alternative is that the focus only enumerates prayer recipients and makes no claim about succession.

changed_reading.before: Parents, a house guest, and believers are unrelated categories in a final supplication.
changed_reading.after: The categories construct a counter-lineage in which birth remains honored but trusted admission, not corrupt reproduction, carries the community forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context traces measured formation through completed shape, successive stages, layers, human growth, return, and renewed exit. In the focus, رب as nurture and completion stands opposite تبار as raw fragments before fashioning. Forgiveness becomes preservation through the formative cycle, while destruction is de-formation back toward unworked matter.

activation_trace.role: Complete and proportioned form supplies the achieved organization that destruction can reverse.
Successive states supply formation as a staged process rather than an instant condition.
Layers placed over one another supply ordered construction by accumulation.
Human growth and nurture supply an organic model of persons being brought toward form.
Return after departure supplies a reversible phase within the larger cycle.
Passing to the outside supplies renewed emergence after return.
Repair, nurture, and completion assign the invoked Lord the constructive direction of the cycle.
Protective covering supplies preservation of formed persons through vulnerability and return.
Raw unworked mineral and fragments supply the material image of form being undone.

structural_cues: 71:14-18 moves from staged creation and layered order through plant-like human growth to return and exit.
71:28 places a nurture-bearing address and protective request before a terminal noun whose branch inventory includes unworked fragments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a formation sequence and the opposed completion and fragment images; I infer a process arrow from care toward maintained form and from wrongdoing toward de-formation. A live alternative is the ordinary juridical contrast of pardon and destruction, with no material cycle intended.

changed_reading.before: تبار names punishment that ends life after a creation reminder.
changed_reading.after: The close opposes two process directions: protective nurture carries formed life through its cycle, while unchecked wrong is reduced from organized form toward fragments.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth is spread as a traversable surface with extended, wide paths; later the prayer seeks no disbelieving resident upon it. The focus then names a faith-qualified entrant into my house. The house reads as a local governed refuge within a mobile world, where residence is not secured by occupying ground but by trusted admission.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the common spatial field on which residence and entry are contested.
Earth as a spread carpet supplies a habitable surface rather than a sealed enclosure.
Passing through a route supplies movement across that surface.
An extended path supplies the channels along which approach and entry become possible.
A broad open road between mountains makes the packet's landscape explicitly permeable.
A person affiliated with or resident in a dwelling supplies the immediately prior problem of who remains housed on earth.
Lordship and ownership supply jurisdiction over the protected dwelling and the wider field.
Entry supplies the decisive crossing from open transit into refuge.
Shelter and dwelling provide the bounded refuge within the traversable earth.
Security and trust make admission, rather than mere occupancy, the basis of protected residence.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 expands earth into a roaded, traversable surface; 71:26 asks that no disbelieving resident remain on it; 71:28 narrows to entry into my house.
The focus qualifies دخل with مؤمنا before expanding to the secure faith collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies open geography, a resident term, and a faith-qualified house entry; I infer a jurisdictional contrast between occupying earth and being admitted to refuge. A live alternative is that earth, resident, and house are only adjacent literal locations without a shared spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: My house is one private location named among the prayer's beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: My house is a governed refuge in a traversable world, and faith marks the difference between mere residence and protected admission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context compresses engulfing, forced entry into fire, and absence of aid into one passive consequence chain. The focus repeats دخل but changes voice, destination, and qualifying state: a person enters a shelter as trusting. House entry is therefore the protected counter-entry to imposed entry into fire.

activation_trace.role: Drowning in water supplies the engulfing first movement of the imposed consequence chain.
Going into an interior supplies the exact movement repeated by the focus with a different destination and agency.
Blazing fire supplies the hostile enclosure into which the contextual entry is forced.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies, by its explicit absence, the closure of that route.
Voluntary entry reuses the movement while reversing its agency and destination.
Shelter and dwelling supply the protected interior opposed to fire.
Settled security and trust name the state in which the counter-entry takes place.

structural_cues: 71:25 uses the passive sequence أغرقوا فأدخلوا نارا and closes with no helpers; 71:28 uses the active دخل بيتي مؤمنا.
The two entry clauses are separated by the request that no disbelieving resident remain and the forecast about their offspring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared entry root, opposed destinations, changed voice, and a faith-state; I infer that the focus entry is constructed as the protected alternative to the prior forced entry. A live alternative is ordinary lexical repetition without deliberate spatial antithesis.

changed_reading.before: The house entrant is simply one more person included in forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: The believing entrant enacts the surah's counter-destination: chosen admission into shelter instead of imposed entry into fire without aid.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the crowd idiom is a form-distant branch from the imperative اغفر; it remains anchored in the supplied غ ف ر inventory and the focus's expansion to all believing men and women. Downstream prose should call it a latent gathering resonance, never translate اغفر itself as gather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: اغفر governs an object list that expands until it explicitly includes both believing collectives.

activation_trace.role: The whole crowd coming together with none left behind supplies a latent assembly image inside the widening pardon list.
A large group or multitude reinforces the scale shift from household relations to a collective.
Household and family provide the initial gathering container that the final plurals exceed.
Shared trusting assent supplies the relation by which the gathered whole coheres.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is distributed separately to every listed recipient.
changed_reading.after: The distribution also faintly gathers its recipients into one complete faith assembly, leaving no class outside the intercession.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because raw mineral and fragments are a secondary material branch of ت ب ر, not the ordinary force of تبارا; it remains anchored in the explicit increase construction and the packet's fragment branch. Downstream prose should present it as a material paradox, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لا تزد الظالمين إلا تبارا grammatically retains increase while restricting what can be increased.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply rising quantity in the paradox.
Raw unworked matter and fragments supply declining organization even as the amount of debris can increase.
Misplacement supplies the loss of proper arrangement that converts an organized whole into misplaced pieces.

changed_reading.before: Increase means a greater degree of a punishment called destruction.
changed_reading.after: Quantity can rise while form falls: there are more fragments and less organized thing, so increase itself becomes the measure of de-formation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ز ي د to ز و د mapping and cannot override the dominant increase sense; it remains anchored to تزد and is reinforced by the context's return and road imagery. Downstream prose should mark it as a split-root material analogy, not a lexical gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تزد carries a packet-resolved non-dominant provision branch beside the focus's terminal تبارا.

activation_trace.role: Carrying provision for a journey supplies the exploratory image of what one bears through transition.
Fragments and unworked matter turn the allotted provision into an anti-provision that cannot sustain ordered continuity.
Destination and return supply the larger transition for which provision would ordinarily be carried.
An extended traversed road supplies the packet's concrete journey frame.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers simply receive destruction as an imposed endpoint.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, their only carried surplus through the transition is fragmentary anti-provision, the collapse of what could sustain a journey.

strongest_changes: The repeated increase-plus-exception clauses turn تبارا into the terminal link of an anti-increment chain rather than an isolated curse.
The rejected protective cover of forgiveness, self-enveloping garments, breached limits, and truth-concealment make اغفر the request for a rival restorative covering.
The forced entry into fire in 71:25 and trusted entry into the house in 71:28 create opposed destinations, while the mixed parent-entrant-believer list builds a counter-lineage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus couples a widening shelter and admission list with tightly governed increase; the context makes both halves one system of coverings, entries, residence, formation, and continuity.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether بيتي should remain primarily a physical dwelling, a household, or a more general governed refuge.
Whether the raw-material de-formation image and the non-dominant provision resonance are useful enough for prose or should remain trace-only outliers.
Whether the shift from قوم to believing men and women deliberately redesigns social boundaries or simply broadens a conventional prayer list.
